scientist_stages.title: Input data and source records
scientist_stages.summary: Bind one trusted protein catalogue and the diffraction datasets to immutable identities before any search begins.
scientist_stages.purpose: Establish which catalogue, annotation source, sequences, MTZ files, and operator declarations are allowed to support the analysis.
inputs: One imported protein catalogue from one annotation source
Diffraction MTZ files and crystal identifiers
User-provided localisation and molecular-weight evidence, when available
Versioned run configuration and database manifests
outputs: Run and source records used by every later stage
decisions: Reject mixed annotation sources
Stop when a required source file is missing, changed, duplicated, or malformed
Preserve every compatible locus when sequences are identical
boundaries: External structure providers cannot create a reportable identity
Missing evidence is not converted into a negative observation
A catalogue import is trusted; taxonomy and gene prediction are out of scope
scientist_stages.warning: Input records are checksum-verified; a changed byte creates a different identity.

scientist_stages.title: Crystallographic preflight
scientist_stages.summary: Select observations, symmetry, resolution, anisotropy, Patterson evidence, and the exact Free-R source before scheduling molecular replacement.
scientist_stages.purpose: Decide whether each diffraction dataset is qualified to proceed, must be held for review, or is invalid.
outputs: Review package marked proceed or needs review
decisions: Proceed only from an authenticated file-based review
Keep data and findings for human inspection when preflight cannot proceed
Fail on inconsistent symmetry, observations, or Free-R identity
boundaries: Preflight qualifies data; it does not identify a protein
Needs Review means Paused before Molecular Replacement: no Molecular Replacement job starts until the issue is resolved
Phenix is an external licensed runtime and is never installed by the workflow
scientist_stages.warning: Qualification and runtime checks exist; fixed-profile evidence remains source- and site-specific.
commands: pixi run -e hpc nextflow run qualification.nf --operation mtz_preflight -stub-run

scientist_stages.title: Discovery and model preparation
scientist_stages.summary: Search bounded providers, preserve no-hits, and prepare coordinate hypotheses without promoting provider labels to catalogue identities.
scientist_stages.purpose: Create a complete eligible model registry and a bounded prepared search set from experimental and predicted structures.
inputs: Versioned local PDB and ProstT5/Foldseek resources
Optional remote ESM Atlas consent and cache
outputs: Provider plans, hits, no-hits, and mapping gaps
Prepared coordinate models with uncertainty and source records
decisions: Keep provider no-hit separate from execution failure
Require explicit consent before remote sequence submission
Retain eligible models outside the first-copy cap for later composition search
boundaries: Predicted models are hypotheses, not experimental evidence
Normal runs never silently prepare databases
Remote responses are versioned and cached by sequence digest
scientist_stages.warning: Individual providers and profiles have different qualification evidence; no-hit remains scientifically valid.

scientist_stages.title: Rank candidates and test Molecular Replacement hypotheses
scientist_stages.summary: Order candidates with explicit priors, enumerate physically plausible copy counts, and run independent first-copy Phaser attempts.
scientist_stages.purpose: Narrow a large candidate/model space into reviewable placement hypotheses while preserving all raw evidence and deferred reasons.
inputs: Catalogue identities and prepared model registry
User-provided localisation and molecular-weight evidence bound at the beginning of the analysis
outputs: Per-hypothesis Phaser commands, placements, scores, and status records
decisions: Retain multiple plausible copy counts
Treat rank and Matthews probability as priors
Continue sibling hypotheses after candidate-specific scientific failure
boundaries: SDS-PAGE mass is an apparent monomer prior, never ASU total mass
A placement is search evidence until reviewed
Rfree is not a high-throughput screening objective
scientist_stages.warning: The scientific path is implemented, but broad fixed-profile qualification is still incomplete.

scientist_stages.title: Review, refine, and read maps
scientist_stages.summary: Confirm the reviewed first-component structure, refine retained states, inspect maps, and narrow identity only as far as the evidence supports.
scientist_stages.purpose: Turn machine-ranked placements into human-reviewed structural states with explicit claim and abstention boundaries.
inputs: Recorded decision for the first placed component
outputs: Approved, rejected, or deferred seed state
decisions: Resolve decisions only through the registered review package
Accept ambiguity or abstention
Separate malformed output from a scientific no-hit
boundaries: Map support may be insufficient to distinguish paralogues or loci
Rwork/Rfree and map-model fit must remain visible
A review decision cannot invent an unregistered state
scientist_stages.warning: Real Phenix and fixed-HPC qualification remain incomplete for some paths.

scientist_stages.title: Bounded composition expansion
scientist_stages.summary: Test up to five additional catalogue components with explicit depth, beam, attempt, and review limits.
scientist_stages.purpose: Test whether additional catalogue components explain residual content without turning search exhaustion into a complete-composition claim.
inputs: Reviewed first-component structure or an approved alternative search state
Parent-bound depth plan and operator composition decisions
outputs: Per-depth attempt inventories and retained parent states
Claim-free terminal composition and sequence review packages
decisions: Retain at most three parent states per depth
Bound work to 25 attempts per depth and 100 additional-component attempts per crystal
Stop on depth, budget, no-model, needs-review status, or no residual content
boundaries: Depth three is positively qualified by 9ECN
Depths four through six are always provisional
No automatic identity or complete-composition claim is made between depths
scientist_stages.warning: Depths 4-6 remain visible but unvalidated and cannot support a complete-composition claim.

scientist_stages.title: Reviewed report and evidence package
scientist_stages.summary: Assemble checksummed results that distinguish supported findings, ambiguity, no-hit, provisional depth, needs-review status, and execution failure.
scientist_stages.purpose: Publish a portable, auditable conclusion whose strength never exceeds the reviewed evidence.
inputs: All owned stage outputs and raw metrics
Execution, environment, database, and checksum manifests
decisions: Refuse claims when required review or source records are absent
Keep scientific status separate from execution status
Publish no-hit and ambiguity as valid completed analyses
boundaries: Models remain hypotheses unless supported by diffraction and review
Exact locus identity is withheld when the map cannot discriminate it
Deeper private analysis remains blocked until every required review gate is complete
scientist_stages.maturity: implemented; deeper private analysis not authorised
scientist_stages.warning: Visible implementation is not run authorisation: required review evidence is still incomplete.

developer_layers.title: Reviewed control plane
developer_layers.summary: Stages only clean immutable commits, fixed profiles, owned inputs, and reviewed site bindings.
developer_layers.purpose: Keep deployment, scheduler submission, collection, and source-of-truth checks outside scientific services and under reviewed operator control.
inputs: Owned run inputs and capability records
decisions: Reject dirty or unreachable source
Permit only reviewed profile/site pairs
Collect and classify before changing code
boundaries: The local repository is the only source of truth
HPC source is never edited
Permission to submit does not imply scientific acceptance
developer_layers.warning: Qualification evidence is exact-source and site-specific.

developer_layers.title: Application entrypoints
developer_layers.summary: phase3_application.nf is the current transitional Phase III entrypoint. The large clean break converges the public application into main.nf beside prepare_databases.nf.
developer_layers.purpose: Expose one explicit application entrypoint and keep database preparation separate from normal analysis.
outputs: Final public main.nf after clean break
decisions: Reject parameters belonging to another entrypoint
Keep prepare_databases.nf separate
Remove superseded roots without compatibility shims
boundaries: Archival main.nf remains v0.2 during transition
phase3_application.nf is not the final public name
Validation remains outside normal analysis
developer_layers.warning: The final main.nf clean break has not yet occurred.

developer_layers.title: Typed Nextflow workflows
developer_layers.summary: DSL2 workflows own channel-item fan-out, scheduling, retries, resume, and publication.
developer_layers.purpose: Express dependency and concurrency without hiding scientific loops inside scripts.
decisions: Fan out independent work
Keep dependent chains explicit
Let the configured executor own concurrency
boundaries: Nextflow does not decide scientific rank or claims
Attempt budgets remain scientific contracts
Cache identity changes with scientific semantics
developer_layers.warning: Individual workflow paths retain separate HPC qualification status.

developer_layers.title: Thin process modules
developer_layers.summary: Each adapter binds typed inputs and performs one efficiently bounded external or Python task.
developer_layers.purpose: Make every scheduled task auditable, cacheable, and independently testable.
decisions: Use efficient batch boundaries
Fail malformed outputs close to the adapter
Keep shell wrappers limited to environment binding
boundaries: No nested scheduler or hidden multi-sample loop
Candidate no-hit is not process failure
Licensed runtimes remain external
developer_layers.warning: Real-runtime qualification varies by external adapter.

developer_layers.title: Python scientific services and contracts
developer_layers.summary: Small services own validation, policy, planning, parsing, status derivation, identifiers, and schemas.
developer_layers.purpose: Centralise scientific invariants and typed state transitions without taking over workflow scheduling.
decisions: Reject malformed or unknown state
Preserve raw metrics
Keep identity, model, and evidence universes separate
boundaries: Python does not schedule independent tasks
Ranks and priors do not become proof
Historical readers stay isolated from active contracts
developer_layers.warning: Active milestone-named surfaces remain queued for the clean break.

developer_layers.title: External runtime boundaries
developer_layers.summary: Phenix, MMseqs2, Foldseek, PSORTb, DeepTMHMM, Slurm, and containers remain narrow versioned adapters.
developer_layers.purpose: Record external commands, versions, licensing, network, and failure behaviour without importing external internals into the application.
inputs: Explicit permission for network or licensed runtime use
decisions: Require explicit remote-sequence consent
Verify Phenix instead of installing it
Keep compute-node network assumptions explicit
boundaries: No automatic Phenix download
Normal analyses never build databases
Provider no-hit remains distinct from outage
developer_layers.warning: Consult the boundary page for each tool's exact qualification state.

developer_layers.title: Evidence, review, and publication
developer_layers.summary: Owned packages, immutable manifests, file-based review, cache records, and verified reports carry every result forward.
developer_layers.purpose: Make every decision and published conclusion traceable to exact source, inputs, commands, and evidence bytes.
decisions: Resolve only registered review packages
Publish no-hit and ambiguity honestly
Refuse claims above validated scope
boundaries: Review is file-based, never interactive on compute nodes
Collection does not upgrade maturity
Private inputs stay outside tracked documentation
developer_layers.warning: All required review evidence must be complete before deeper private analysis.
